cases.description: Should trigger: planning requested before a build
cases.input: Write an implementation plan before we start building the checkout redesign.
cases.expect: Produces a decision-first plan with tweakable decisions, known unknowns, compressed mechanical work
assertions: Opens with 3-line summary including riskiest assumption
Section 1 lists decisions user will likely tweak with alternatives and change costs
Section 2 names known unknowns with defaults and pivot signals
Ends with 2-4 specific yes/no review items

cases.description: Should trigger: explicit plan request, modest scope
cases.input: Can you plan the refactor of our auth module?
cases.expect: Produces an implementation plan ordering by likelihood-of-tweaking, not build order
assertions: Leaves room for improvisation during implementation

cases.description: Not trigger: no plan requested, direct build
Not trigger: brainstorming phase, not planning
cases.input: What features could we add next quarter?

cases.description: Should trigger: decisions-tweakable section for API shape choice
cases.input: Plan the new API shape. There are two options — put the choice and what changing it later would cost in the plan.
cases.expect: Section 1 lists the API-shape decision with one alternative and the cost of changing later
assertions: Opens with a three-line summary incl. riskiest assumption
Lists the decision, one alternative, and change-later cost
Names known unknowns with pivot signals
